vcs.action.title: Action on the code host
vcs.action.what: Writes to the code host (GitLab, GitHub or Bitbucket), visible to the team. Below is exactly what will be sent.
vcs.card.ciManual: CI waiting for a manual job
vcs.error.auth: {host} rejected the credential (HTTP {status}). Check the token or log in to the CLI again.
vcs.error.cli_missing: The command {command} was not found. Install it or choose API access.
vcs.error.forbidden: {host} denied access (HTTP {status}): the token lacks the required permission. {detail}
vcs.error.no_token: Integration {id} has no token: set the secret "{ref}" in Settings.
vcs.error.not_configured: This workspace has no {kind} integration configured.
vcs.error.rate_limited: {host} rate-limited the requests. Try again in {seconds} s.
vcs.health.noToken: Integration {id} has neither a CLI nor a token configured.
vcs.probe.bitbucketRepos: On Bitbucket, issues and requested reviews are looked up in the configured repositories; none was given.
vcs.probe.cliLogin: Access uses the {command} CLI login: permissions are those of that session.
vcs.probe.mrs: {count} open merge/pull request(s) of yours or requested from you.
vcs.probe.scopesUnknown: The host does not report this token's permissions; the reads below show what it can reach.
vcs.probe.writesNeed: For the app to propose and run writes (comments, status, reviewers) the token also needs: {scopes}. Without it the app only reads.
vcs.reviewer.noAccess: {user} has no review access in the project
vcs.validate.body: request body is not in the allowed shape
vcs.validate.githubGraphql: GraphQL is only allowed to resolve a review thread or to mark a pull request ready or draft
vcs.validate.gitlabGraphql: GraphQL is only allowed for the work item status change (workItemUpdate with statusWidget)
vcs.write.guard: write to the code host (GitLab, GitHub or Bitbucket), push a branch or publish a comment
vcs.write.statusNoNode: the issue has no global id to change its status
vcs.write.statusOpenClosed: only opening or closing the issue (open, closed)
updates.title: Updates
updates.badge.title: Open Settings › Updates
updates.mode.label: How the app was installed
updates.mode.release: Published release: the app updates itself
updates.mode.source: Source tree: updates by rebuilding it
updates.mode.setting.label: Update mode
updates.reason.source: Installed by scripts/install-local.sh from a source tree that still exists.
updates.reason.package: Installed from the .deb package: the package manager (apt or dpkg) updates it. The app does not update itself.
updates.reason.dev: The app is running from source (development). Run scripts/update.sh in a terminal to install.
updates.reason.feed-missing: This build has no update feed (app-update.yml).
updates.reason.feed-placeholder: The update feed is still a placeholder (owner/repo in electron-builder.yml). Nothing is requested from the network.
updates.reason.feed-insecure: The update feed does not use HTTPS. Updates only come over HTTPS.
updates.reason.feed-unsupported: The configured update provider is not supported (use github or generic).
updates.reason.source-missing: The recorded source tree no longer exists.
updates.reason.source-unknown: There is no record of which source tree this install came from (run scripts/install-local.sh in it).
updates.signing: On Windows and macOS automatic updates only work with signed binaries (code signing). These builds are not signed yet.
updates.channel.label: Channel
updates.channel.beta.hint: Gets test versions early, with a higher chance of bugs.
updates.auto.label: Check for updates automatically
updates.auto.hint: When the app starts and then at the interval below. Off, only when you ask.
updates.interval.label: Check every
updates.last.label: Last check
updates.last.never: Not checked yet in this session.
updates.release.downloaded: Version {version} has been downloaded and is ready.
updates.release.installing: Installing version {version}. The app restarts by itself.
updates.release.busy: A ceremony, a call or a job is running. The day's state is saved, but they are interrupted.
updates.release.installOnQuit: If you prefer, it is installed the next time you quit the app.
updates.notes.title: What changed
updates.downgrade.label: Go back to the stable version
updates.downgrade.hint: You are on a beta version. This switches to the latest stable one even if it is older. It is the only way to move to an older version.
updates.source.heading: Source tree
updates.source.explain: Rebuilds from the code in {dir}, quits the app, installs the new version and opens it again.
updates.source.head: Latest on main
updates.source.remoteAhead_one: The remote (origin/main) has {count} commit the local main does not: pull in the tree to include it.
updates.source.remoteAhead_other: The remote (origin/main) has {count} commits the local main does not: pull in the tree to include them.
updates.source.fetch.label: Fetch from the remote (git fetch) when checking
updates.source.fetch.hint: Off, the check only reads the local tree and writes nothing to it.
updates.source.error.no-dir: The source tree was not found.
updates.source.error.not-a-repo: The source tree folder is not a git repository.
updates.source.error.no-main: The source tree has no main branch.
updates.source.error.commit-unknown: The installed commit ({detail}) is not in this tree.
updates.source.confirm.title: Update the app
updates.source.confirm.body: The build takes a few minutes. When it ends, the app quits and opens again on the new version. The day's ceremony and the actions stay saved; running jobs (agents, voice) are interrupted.
updates.source.started: Updating. The app stays open during the build and quits by itself at the end; follow it in {path}.
updates.source.devNote: This only works in the installed app. Here, in development, run scripts/update.sh in a terminal.
updates.error.interval: The interval must be a whole number of hours between 1 and 168.
updates.error.inactive: The updater is not active in this install.
updates.error.dev: Only works in the installed app. In development, run scripts/update.sh in a terminal.
updates.error.noSource: This install has no record of its source tree. Run scripts/install-local.sh in it.
